cues: Sadi Carnot asked the deepest question of all.
What is the greatest efficiency any engine could have, working between two given temperatures?
His answer was an imaginary engine, perfectly reversible, running this cycle.
The working substance is an ideal gas in a cylinder with perfectly insulating walls and a perfectly conducting base.
